title: PluralLLM: Pluralistic Alignment in LLMs via Federated Learning
reasoning: The paper focuses on a federated learning framework for 'pluralistic alignment', which aims to represent diverse human values. While it discusses fairness and avoiding harmful ideologies, its primary technical contribution and evaluation are focused on group fairness metrics and preference alignment on social/political survey data, rather than benchmarking religion, theology, or specific moral frameworks.
